Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, listen up, ladies. The Mayor has tasked us, Troop 46231, with baking the official droogen strudel for the tasting today. The key to making droogen strudel is the raisin-like dried doonkelberries called the droogen. Now, there are going to be actual Drusselsteinian emissaries here at the fair. And these emissaries are real sticklers about their droogen strudel, so no distractions. Every fiber of our full attention must be laser-focused on this task! I wonder what Phineas and Ferb are up to.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: "Stickiness is the most underrated of all the -nesses, and of all the stickinesses, the sap of the maracanut tree is the sticky-messiest. This Temple of Sap attraction is a monument to the rare and beautiful maracanut tree, the world's greatest stickerizer." Looks like we've tracked our quarry to its lair, girls! Although, if their biggest attraction was a sap-themed ride, I understand why this place closed down. Girls, get your gear. We're climbin' up.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We're in luck! Looks like we're here before the mail's come! Okay, girls, let's seal off this area! Holly, you go take up a scanning position one half-klick to the north! Ginger, you got the south! The rest of you, fan out! We've got to intercept that letter! I'm going in back to keep Phineas distracted. Any questions?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It looks like a T. rex footprint to me. Hey, look! A message! "Time machine destroyed! Stuck in 300,000,000 BC. Please help! Signed Phineas, Ferb, and Candaaaaaccccce." Our friends need our help. Please turn to the "time travel" section of your Fireside Girls handbook. Hey, has anyone seen Perry?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, come on, Isabella. What's so bad about writing a letter and expressing my feelings? Feelings are natural. Phineas is natural. We are both natural beings in the world. With feelings? Aw. Did I really refer to him as "my little crumb cake"? Who does that? Come in, Fireside Girls!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, let me get this straight; You'll do all the work, while I spend the day with Phineas? Hmm.... Deal. But do you know anyone that can work a state-of-the-art soundboard? Someone who can edit huge digital files? Someone who can understand basic mic-ing techniques?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And it's not over now! Cause when the going gets tough... the tough get going! Come on, girls, we've got enough patches between all of us to make this work! We can do this! Gretchen, Milly, Katie, you've got the exploring patch, right?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, here we are, I guess. Oh, I get it! It was actually called "The Old Abandoned Amusement Park"! And now it's old and abandoned. Hence, "old abandoned" twice. Girls, we're goin' in. We have a tree to find! Fireside Girls, report!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wednesday, Wednesday, Wednesday! Giant monster truck rally right here in Danville! Candace the Crusher takes on all comers! Be there, be there, be there! We'll give you the whole seat, but you'll only need the edge! Thanks, Dink.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Candace, we are all very impressed. You earned more patches in one day than anyone in the history of the Fireside Girls: 49 patches, which pretty much blows away the previous record of 6 patches held by our own Adyson Sweetwater.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh, I know! It's all right here in Tween Bleep magazine. "Three Sure-Fire Ways to Lift Your Friend Out of a Serious Funk. Number one: Give her a complete make-over. A completely different look will often do the trick."

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. You might wanna go check up on Baljeet. I was walking by his house and heard him scream... "**AIIIEEEE!!! I'M DOOMED TO BE AN INCOMPETENT FLUNKEE FOREVER!!!** Ever...ever...ever..." I added the echo part.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, where are you? There's this giant robot machine attacking downtown Danville! I'm all alone here! Call me as soon as you get this. Come on, Isabella, this is what being an intrepid reporter is all about!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: My mother, New Hampshire Garcia-Shapiro, was searching for the Temple when she disappeared! I'm afraid something terrible has happened to her! You've just gotta help me! I'm also a certified Damsel in Distress.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: According to my Fireside Girls manual each one of those flags has a meaning. The blue flag means crab season and the yellow flag means hold the mustard, and that last one, I'm not sure what that one means.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look. My client gets 3% of the gross and a piece of the back end, or he walks. Yeah, that's right. You mess with the bull, you get the horns, buddy. Hello? Syd, baby, you got that 3rd act in line yet?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, I just came by to tell you I can't join in on the fun today. I've been charged of the task of recording the audio book version of the Fireside Girls Compendium Guide, it's gonna take forever.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Did you know the African chapter of the Fireside Girls has its own special edition survival patches? "Identifying fauna and flora." Easy. "Finding water." Hmf. Child's play. And, "eating a grub"?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Dude! This is just the table of contents. The actual book is being transported from a secret bunker to our recording studio at the Fireside Girl Lodge. Seriously, this is going to take me a week.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, according to our data, this is the relative position of the sun, and this is where the Earth should be on its orbit this summer. But for some reason, we're here. Tennis balls don't lie.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow! Humans really take for granted not being sucked into the nearest vacuum cleaner. I'm gonna see if the queen knows anything. Excuse me, Your Majesty, do you have any idea how to get out?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, guys! Food's up! Aw, just think, this may be the last time I'm stuffing your faces before I'm off to school. I got it, Mom! Anyway, enjoy! Gotta treat my Fireside Girl alums right.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We may be the only non-pharmacists left in Danville. I think I figured out where this started. And if we could get there, we might be able to figure out how it started and reverse it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks for letting us host the French Fireside Girls at your cabin this afternoon, Mr. and Mrs. Flynn. This'll be a great place for them to get their North American Tracking patches.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Right, right! You're right. But still, if we don't succeed today, the 'two strikes and you're out' rule kicks in, which means this spot will stay empty on all of our sashes forever!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Alright, girls, come to order. Now, just fill out this application, read through the training manual, sign the insurance waivers, and you can be sworn in at our meeting next week.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's not the Phineas Flynn that I fell in... ...to...this...situation with. You showed us all on Ferb's map how this is possible and I'm not gonna let you sit there and --

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks for showing me the old scrapbooks, Nana. I love hearing about the old days. Tell me again about string art. And what was it like to get up and change the channel on the TV?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks, Ferb. I just don't know what to do... we were in Paris! The most romantic city in the world, and... he didn't even notice me! I just feel like giving up, and look at him!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sorry, but you know, it was the best day for me! Due to my incurable case of the hiccups, I spent an entire day showered with undivided attention from Phineas! It was wonderful!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What have you guys gotten me into?! We're caught in a tractor beam! My engines can't pull us free! Looks like we're gonna have to shoot our way out! I'm powering up the turrets!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But we do have access to Phineas and Ferb. And they have access to a sorbet machine that turned Candace into a fly. They've gotta be able to modify it to turn people into bees.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I have just earned my 24 Hours of Silence Patch! I can see why you don't talk much, Ferb. I actually quite enjoyed it. I ended up having an inner dialogue with myself all day.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Ferb! We were just discussing our plans for Phineas' birthday. The circus we ordered won't be arriving until later in the day, but Irving had a great idea for a warm-up.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I just earned my milking badge, and it was so easy. All you do is squeeze and pull and squeeze and pull and squeeze and pull and squeeze and pull, and- so, whatcha doin'?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, um... we don't celebrate Christmas. But I got the coolest stuff for Hanukkah: Eight straight days of dreams come true! I mean... I'm with you guys. Boo, no Christmas.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, I once saw Ferb playing an entire game of soccer using a pumpkin! And he didn't even break it! To this day, his motivation for doing so remains shrouded in mystery.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I just mailed a letter stating my true feelings to Phineas and we need to stop him before he reads it! This mission is top priority! I call it "Operation Crumb Cake"!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What?! You mean this was your fault the whole time?! This isn't over. Okay, ladies. I think we've more than earned these Preventing-an-International-Incident patches.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Solo's been a thorn in my side for years. My ship, the Centennial Chihuahua, was on pace to finish the Kessel Run in eleven parsecs, and that nerf-herder cut me off!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's what I kept trying to tell you, Candace, but you were so insistent on becoming a Fireside Girl. Maybe you can start working on your Good Listener Patch next.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We'll never catch them this way! But we will get that letter back, no matter how nicely or politely we have to ask! We'll cut them off at Phineas's house. Let's go!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, girls, festivities are over. Let's focus on getting our beekeeping patches. It's the only patch that we've ever tried to get and failed. Remember last year?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Le Filles à côté du Feu, to earn your North American Tracking Patch, you'll have to capture the most dangerous of creatures, the vicious, American, grizzly bear.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: "A troop leader may award full Fireside Girl status to any girl who has earned 50 patches." But, Mrs. Feyersied, 50 patches in one day?! Is that even possible?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I can't lie, girls. I'm tempted to join you all in the chaos. Maybe there's a patch at the end of this very dark tunnel, but for the first time, I don't know...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, Phineas! Get it together, Fireside Girl! It's up to you to save Phineas! It's up to you to save Danville! It's up to you... to stop talking to yourself!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh no! Meap needs our help, Phineas, Phineas! Come on Phineas, snap out of it! Phineas, Meap is down, he's been out-cuted. What are we gonna do? Phineas?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks for helping me set up for the Latke Festival this year, guys! It'll really go a long way toward helping me get that Golden Years Assistant patch.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, Phineas, yes! I've been right here in front of you all along just waiting for you to -- Oh...wait. You were talking about the puppet, weren't you?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah. It was like, "Isabella...blah blah blah blah blah...Isabella...blah blah blah blah blah..." He was dressed like an astronaut! I was distracted!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So you see, Phineas, I can only earn the patch by walking up to someone I care about and telling them face-to-face that I've got a huge crush on you.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh! Um, well, eh... It says here, "In the incredibly unlikely event of a tie vote, just vote again." Hmm. All in favor of vanilla, raise your hand.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, do you think it would work on my dog, Pinky? He barks at the door when a doorbell rings on TV. I'd love to explain the whole concept to him.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Seems like only yesterday I walked through that side gate and asked "Whatcha doin?" when you were building that rollercoaster for the first time.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What? Over? Did you say "over"? Nothing is over until we decide it is! Was it over when we helped Candace get fifty patches in one day? Heck no!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No, I really need to talk to you and I'm just gonna jump right to it! The thing about that Emotional Bravery Patch is that I need to tell you...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no, this is terrible! I'm so glad you're here with me, Phineas! Come on, we can cover the action better from the top of City Hall! Phineas?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: An All Terrain Vehicle. With an electromagnetic motor, super rubber tank treads, high speed ceramic body, hydraulics and all remote controlled.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, we've gotten water from a cactus, witnessed a mirage, and learned the difference between sunstroke and heatstroke. Thanks for that, Adyson.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, sorry, I -- I only have one extra ticket, and...it's sold out. So, I thought maybe Phineas and I would go—uh, not to necessarily exclude --

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm sorry, but the traditional procedure comes straight from the Fireside Rules of Order, as established by our founder, Eliza M. Feyersied.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh! What's it gonna be? Suspense, stalker, horror, action adventure, or my personal favorite, the campy costume alien teen romance dramedy?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You do realize that's a worst-case scenario, right, Candace? But I do feel for ya. I've been trying to ask Phineas to that same dance all–

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Isabella Garcia-Shapiro. Femme fatale, ingenue, amateur archeologist, and licensed tile and grout installer. A girl has to earn a living!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes, it's true that the Paisley Sideburn Brothers tickets can only be ordered by an active-duty Fireside Girl. But if you just want to—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great job on the snow chalet, guys! It's amazing how the cocoa stays hot in these double-walled ice cups. How are you feeling, Phineas?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So I guess we'll go ahead and start! Our trusty Fireside Handbook has some guidelines to follow, starting with the compliment session.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay. But if we're doing this, we're doing it Isa-style! We're making the ultimate droogen strudel. The biggest one they've ever seen!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. We should bring Phineas in for a pit stop. All right, Fireside Girls, let's move, move, move! That helmet looks so manly.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm sorry. Let's just, um... Okay. Here's an idea from the "One of those days" section. Let's all hold hands and sing a jovial song.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You built a rollercoaster through downtown! You made giant tree-house robots! You traveled through time for crying out loud! Twice!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, girls. We're dealing with a 426 cubic inch, fully-blown V8, with hypo lifters, radical cam, and a limited-slip differential.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And I need your help to find him. I thought there might be some clues in the photos I took that could help him stop Khaka Peu Peu.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You guys are the greatest! Okay, according to the Fireside Girl handbook, we can find water in cacti. Now, don't make it too easy!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It could be the biggest game in the world, and girls could still beat boys. Biggest game in the world. Did you get that, Phineas?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Add this to your bag, my good sir. So Nana, when Grandpa got your letter, did he come running to you and sweep you into his arms?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It worked! All right, Pinky-Winky, time for some cheesy-weesy! No, Pinky! Chasing the cat is so cliche! You're better than that!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I did, it's the time machine that moved. I brought back a woolly mammoth's tusk, a Viking helmet, and smallpox. And the vaccine.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: There you are, Isabella! I made a funny. It's always humorous when one refers to oneself in the third-person. You try it, Pinky.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, not a hard and fast rule, I guess. What's that? I hear a sash calling me to earn it some more new patches. Come on, Pinky.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, let's see if it fools them. Uh, Dockin' Bay control, ya got us cott in a track-ta beam heeyuh! Ya guys want donuts or not?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Mrs. Feyersied? One second please. Good evening, ma'am. Fireside Girl Isabella Garcia-Shapiro Troop 46231. What's the emergency?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, guys, this is amazing! I was afraid you guys were gonna go overboard and build some giant sundae contraption or something!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This is it, Isabella: The day you're going to insist on spending some time alone with Phineas! I can do this! What'cha doooin'?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You know, Buford's kind of right. These smoothies are sort of exotic, but I think we can do better. What do you think, Phineas?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I hear you. None of the women superheroes showed up, so it's all about testosterone and...powers and...fighting, which... yeah.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, I do have the most patches. So yes, I probably do have that basic patch! Um, what I mean to say is... Let's focus, girls.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I would harness the power of rainbows, unicorns, and sweetness to defend all that is good and just. I'd become... The Rainbow.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. The girls have finished pitching the tents. Can you sign here for our Tent Pitching achievement patches please?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay. We've got 78 complaints about food quantity, 42 requests for belly rubs, and we're still trying to explain TV to Pinky.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Noooo, through teamwork! See that mountain over there? It used to be over there. With a little teamwork, you can do anything.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, uh, Phineas, I was wondering if maybe after this, you'd like to go to the premiere of the new Stumbleberry Finkbat movie.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Not very well. We started a bake sale... ...then we tried cat-sitting... ...even a lemonade stand... ...but, nothing worked.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yay! We made it across the desert! Say, Phineas, I don't suppose you could help us out with our Rainforest Navigation Patch?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: These pieces of hair and dust are like rope! Holly, Ginger, you girls have the advanced knot-tying patch. What do you think?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well it's a lucky thing you accidentally hammered yourself into that crate marked temple expedition supplies then isn't it?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, when my favorite series, The Goblin's Filibuster, ended, I made an undisclosed amount of fan-fiction to hold me over.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, I'm totally blowing it! I feel strong when I walk up to Phineas, but as soon as I open my mouth, I completely choke!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, I've seen one of these before. According to the Fireside Girls' Manual, that lizard is a North American chameleon.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What am I going to do? Have you ever seen senior citizens riot? It's like a slow gray tornado of canes and false teeth!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Alright girls, Union Jack is back. Operation: Perfect Picnic is now Operation: Ginormous Non-romantic Overblown Picnic.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Tell you what I'm going to do, Buford. I'm going to take this ball and I'm going to hit it into your goal in one shot.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm sorry, Candace. Y'know, you may not have lit up the entire board, but you did demonstrate remarkable persistence.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Under normal circumstances, I'd say yes. But this one seems to have a ... ..."Storming of the Bastille" sort of vibe.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Just doing my Fireside Girl thing! I packed it with some Mexican-Jewish delicacies like... gefilte-flan! It wobbles.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This is not a friendship, it's a spaceship! So don't invade mine! We're coming out of hyperspace! Buckle up, ladies!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's okay, Phineas. I still appreciate all the help. And something tells me I'm gonna treasure this photo even more.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The Amulet of Juatchadoon! The legend says it can awaken an evil corn colossus with the power to destroy the world!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Something like that. In the meantime, I'd like to introduce you to a little thing the kids are calling "ice cream".

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hmm. I don't remember a single time we didn't unanimously pick the same thing, then rejoice in a harmonized shriek.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, since you obviously won't figure this out on your own, I think I'm the one causing the cute interference.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It has to be around here somewhere. Creepy roadside hippie gurus are generally reliable. Wait, I think I found it!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's as if I don't exist! I would give anything if he would just sit down with me and enjoy this beautiful sunset.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're here! The French Fireside Girls! Or Le Filles à côté du Feu, as they're known in their country of origin.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You need another jump-start? Candace, didn't you have the engine running when we were talking on the videophone?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, what are you doing? You're putting your entire world view on the line. And for what? A bunch of bikes?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I love it when Phineas uses unnecessarily long words for common things like brushing your teeth and washing up.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Adyson, you were the first to earn a Cupcake Delivery patch. How about you deliver your trash to the trash can?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Right. While you two were busy making sure your summer day was "fun", other people were busy saving Danville.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's been great sharing this bonding moment with you two, but we need to get off this crumbling mountain now!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: There's no reason you can't do that, but you have to make room in your life for other things like fun and...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wait, what's happening? We've never gone off pitch! Is there a full moon tonight? Is Mercury in retrograde?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Don't worry, Candace. The week will be over before you know it. At least you got a love scene on a bridge.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, the old hippie didn't mention how to get to the top of that, all he gave us was this Key of Wisdom.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Guys, what would you rather do? Watch paint dry or lasso wild dolphins and ride em' across the high seas?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh! Right. Right. The Fireside Girls are going for our Beekeeping patch, and we need to borrow something.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Calm down, girls. Have you forgotten who we are? We're Fireside Girls Troop 46321, and we never give up!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, Isabella, here it is. He's finally going to know how you really feel. There's no turning back now.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Candace, I thought you were going to take it easy. Whatever happened to that whole Jeremy Johnson thing?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah! Mockmacaws! Rare migratory birds that can camouflage themselves with their color-changing plumage.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh-uh-uh! Some would say I got most of these Safety Patches from pullin' your biscuits out of the fire.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: As you all know, the annual Fireside Cupcake Jamboree is coming up, and we have a big decision to make—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Meap! Your planet's so cute! Except, I guess, for that evil-looking fortress under that ominous cloud.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look! Ooh! It's the rare bent-bill nuthatch! Isn't she beautiful? She's finding material for her nest.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah. I'm going two weeks early because I'm an R.A., and in soccer, debate camp, student government...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay... Now that we want to get across, it sure would be nice to have a grappling hook and some rope.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Now we just need to either collect a sand sample, measure the temperature, or milk a camel. You guys!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Awww, they're so cute and tiny a squirrel could surf on them. Now, if we only had a box of squirrels.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How can you tell they're Capri pants? Maybe they're just regular pants for someone with shorter legs.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no, thanks. I already had breakfast. You know, I've never really seen one of these in real life.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Isabella Garcia-Shapiro, the Fireside Girl Gazette. Would it be okay if I asked you a few questions?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: As promised, the Millennium Falcon. I should be able to catch him before he gets to that small moon.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Do we have chopped liver? What do you think this place is? Chopped li— Oh, that doesn't really work.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh. Thanks. So, would you like to go to the Night of the Falling Stars Girls' Choice Dance tonight?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure, I still have to get my "You wouldn't know cute if it bit your legs off" accomplishment patch.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, it looks like the Unearthing Ancient Container patch I earned is finally gonna come in handy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, Buford, pop the balloon and win a prize! Miss it and my future mother-in-law is gone forever.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, okay. I understand. You know, you want to keep yourself open to other drink options. I get it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well yeah, but...it's an Emotional Bravery Patch that I can only earn by walking up to somebody I—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They've been appearing in fields all over Danville! Some people think they're made by spaceships!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Augh! What I was going to say is all I want for my birthday is some alone time with-- Never mind.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, the mockmacaws are here, but they keep camouflaging every time I try to take their picture.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look! The last shard of Darkling Dungeon! That's what we need to complete the quest in the story!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, good luck. My troop and I are going to the local fossils exhibit. Catch up with you later!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Little Duffers has closed its doors forever. And I was all set to destroy you on the mini links.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay. I hereby nominate Candace Flynn into membership in the Loyal Sisterhood of Fireside Girls.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, I'm back! Phineas? Ferb? Well, I guess there goes my Early Mid-Morning Edition story...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't know, I can't see the bottom. But it almost doesn't matter, so long as we get across it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I found some coat hangers from that Leaning Tower of Closet Space and an old college sweatshirt.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You're either really brave or really stupid! Well, kid, looks like your luck hasn't run out yet.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, we have to do something. We can't have nothing to show for our day when Phineas gets here.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I wonder what would make someone want to build something to destroy romance in the first place.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Gross, but cool! But Pinky will eat anything but dog food. He likes grilled cheese sandwiches.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Awesome! I knew I could count on you for the coolest story ever! Have you attempted a run yet?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: He's been gone all morning! He didn't even touch his breakfast burrito. What am I going to do?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, uh...let's switch places. The light catches the foons so beautifully from this angle.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, ladies. I think we should stick to cupcakes. Let's just pick one. Red velvet or vanilla?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Can me and the other Fireside Girls be lifeguards? We need to earn our Aquatic-Safety badges.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Very impressive! Need any help? The Fireside Girls and I are trying to get our sewing badges.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's okay. It's just kind of weird for me not to know where you are or whatcha doin'.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, let's see...setting, targets... "Fireside Girls..." And that should do it. Here we go.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's safer than being eaten by a giant fish monster! Move over, Candace! Everybody, hold on!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool. See you tomorrow. It really was the coolest coaster ever. You guys make a great team.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, Phineas! Oh, my gosh. What did he say? What does he need? I was in Phineasland again.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Umm, okay. I'll just stay here with my "Expert Makeover" patches and... Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, I'll be back in an hour. Hopefully I can make the Early Mid-Morning Edition! See ya!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, Phineas? We've been thinking, too, and isn't it time we, you know, found our way back?
